title: Allan Gray business update
author: Carl Lategan
body:
Since the last Allan Gray business and investment updates, we have made some changes to our local and offshore investment platforms. During a recent webinar, Carl Lategan discussed these enhancements in detail, explained the new Allan Gray Offshore Investment Platform administration fee structure and shared some of the exciting projects currently underway. You can watch the 10-minute recording below anddownload the presentation slides here.

The Allan Gray business and investment updates included a local and offshore update presented by portfolio manager, Jacques Plaut, and a Q&A session with portfolio managers from Allan Gray and Orbis hosted by head of Retail Distribution, Tamryn Lamb. Links to recordings of these sessions are available below.
